title: An old habit returns
explanation: The source uses the curved tail as an image of a persistent disposition. In ordinary conversation it can express frustration when a habit returns; it does not prove that people are incapable of change.
meaning_odia: ବାରମ୍ବାର ପୁରୁଣା ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଫେରିଆସିଲେ ବିରକ୍ତିରେ କୁକୁରର ବଙ୍କା ଲାଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ ସହ ତୁଳନା କରାଯାଏ। ବଦଳ ହେଲା ବୋଲି ଆଶା କରିବା ପରେ ପୁଣି ସେହି କାମ ଦେଖିବାର ହତାଶା ଏଥିରେ ଅଛି। କିନ୍ତୁ ଏହି ଉପମା ମଣିଷ କେବେ ବଦଳିପାରିବେ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Someone repeatedly returns to interrupting others despite promising to listen. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source’s fixed-nature gloss is reported as a proverbial attitude, not endorsed as psychology or a judgment on a whole group.
